name: Sync main to qa

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Mirror main into qa
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:qa --force
